results.title: Defect reproduced: three partial sessions that logged only the lighter BACK-OFF sets after a top-set session must not read as a four-exposure deterioration (ACT)
Back-off sets never enter the top-set series: a session with a top set and lighter back-offs contributes its TOP set (same value as before the change)
A genuine decline of the TOP set is still detected: four exposures with a falling top set still reach ACT (valid evidence is preserved)
Back-off sets of OTHER methods and straight sets are untouched: a straight-set series still compares every set (best per exposure)

The same holds for the app's default bench method, Primer + Paused Top/Back-Offs (the method Bench Press (BB) actually uses): back-off-only partials never read as ACT, a real top-set decline still does
Methods whose later sets are NOT lighter back-offs keep every set in the series: Heavy Primer + Work Sets, Straight Heavy Sets and Cluster Sets are untouched (set 2 can still be the best set)
Defect reproduced: ONE session whose sets straddle UTC midnight is one exposure, not two
Controls: two separate sessions on adjacent days stay two exposures; two sessions on the same UTC day still merge to the best set as before
Legacy records without a session id keep the old day grouping (no data is dropped or re-dated)
Defect reproduced: sets logged in an UNFINISHED draft do not enter the evidence of finished sessions
The same sets count as soon as the session is finished (nothing is lost, only deferred)
A live workout does not move the evidence: logging a light set in the running (draft) session leaves the decision unchanged, and nothing is written
Records with no matching session (legacy or older install) are NOT excluded: only records that belong to a DRAFT session are held back
Defect reproduced: after a full Top Set + Back-Offs session the NEXT target is built from the TOP set, not from the last (lighter) back-off set
A back-off-only partial session does not lower the target: NEXT keeps the most recent TOP set (no performance is inferred from the omitted top set)
Only back-offs ever logged: no top set exists, so no target weight is invented from a back-off ("Establish ... baseline")
Straight Heavy Sets: the target anchors on the best set of the latest session even when the last set was lighter through fatigue; an earlier heavier session does not override the latest one
targetMode (intensifier modes) also anchors on the best set of the latest session, not the last logged one; time/rep exercises keep their text
Target text for the other strength methods is unchanged (no history -> establish baseline; method-specific guidance text identical)
The workout screen shows the corrected NEXT target for the exercise (end to end), using the exercise's actual default strength method
Same anchoring for Primer + Paused Top/Back-Offs: top set after a full session, and no weight invented from back-offs alone
Preserved: a finished partial session in which only one exercise was done still adds that exercise's exposure; omitted exercises do not read as decline
Nothing raises a load automatically: the decision functions still only report OBSERVE / INVESTIGATE / ACT about a decline
Reading evidence never writes: pa_hist and pa_sessions_v2 are byte-identical after every decision and target call
Structured intensifier blocks still never enter the evidence series
Full Session prescriptions are untouched: slot table and set counts are unchanged by the evidence code
